final: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), total AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_count FROM major_counts), shares AS (SELECT mc.link_to_major, mc.member_count, mc.member_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.total_count, 0) AS share FROM major_counts AS mc CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.member_count), AVG(s.share), AVG(s.share - m.value) FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN mean_share AS m WHERE m.value IS NOT NULL AND s.share > m.value
